title: Absolutist Expedition Trunk
summary: Locked expedition trunk with 100 HP and Medium Toughness.

fields.Use: Open with the Absolutist Expedition Key near the Grymforge entrance to the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Durability: 100 object HP. Medium Toughness requires at least 22 damage from a single hit to damage it. Resistant to Piercing, Necrotic, and Radiant, and immune to Poison and Psychic.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
